summary: scripts/check-public-repo refuses two more real host names. The release notes that merged before the names were listed may still name those two while their content is exactly what merged, since merged notes are immutable; every other host and every other check still applies to them. One workflow-source comment no longer names a host. CI's full-history fetch no longer leaves a broken checkout when a transfer fails: the one-commit checkout's shallow marker is restored, a dropped transfer (HTTP 408/429/5xx, hang-up, timeout) is fetched once more, and any other failure still fails the step.

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Repository check, CI workflow steps and a comment only; no runtime behavior changes. A history fetch that GitHub drops is tried once more instead of failing the job.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit and regenerate the workflows with genie.
